findings.title: Suppressed renal-replacement outcome labelled as pooled

evidence.quote: DESIGN REFUSAL: after refusing reconstructed non-parallel designs without an explicit design adjustment, only k=1 trial(s) remain; no pooled number is rendered. Remaining and refused trials are named below.

findings.why: The 'Pooled in' column includes New renal-replacement therapy, although its result explicitly refuses a pooled estimate.
findings.fix: Distinguish extracted trial rows from outcomes actually pooled, and display the recorded suppression reason.

findings.title: Heading hierarchy skips from h3 to h5
findings.why: The preceding heading inside this tab is h3, 'Known eligible trials not in this pool, and what they would do'. The next heading skips h4, disrupting heading navigation.
findings.fix: Make the known-eligible-trials subsection an h5 under the outcome h4, alongside the compatibility subsection.

findings.title: Suppressed harm syntheses labelled as pooled

evidence.quote: "basis": "No quantitative safety conclusion while source-reporting trials remain unresolved"

findings.why: The 'Pooled in' column lists Gastrointestinal adverse effects and, on another row, Non-cardiovascular death. Both outcomes have suppressed syntheses in the review object.
findings.fix: Label these as extracted evidence with synthesis suppressed, rather than pooled outcomes.

findings.title: Incompatible, suppressed hyperglycaemia synthesis labelled as pooled
findings.why: Four trial rows list Hyperglycaemia under 'Pooled in', although its synthesis is suppressed for incompatible estimands and incomplete harm extraction.
findings.fix: Show these as extracted trial rows with the recorded suppression status; reserve 'Pooled in' for served syntheses.
